disease_susceptibility_profile.condition: Tomato Mosaic Virus (ToMV) & Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV)
disease_susceptibility_profile.pathogen: Tomato mosaic virus / Tobacco mosaic virus (Tobamovirus)
disease_susceptibility_profile.interpretation: Genotype '0/1' (HET) at Tm-2^2 (p.Glu520Lys). Result: Conferred Resistance. Functional missense substitution in CC-NBS-LRR C-terminal domain conferring broad-spectrum durable resistance against Tomato Mosaic Virus (ToMV) and Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV).
disease_susceptibility_profile.environmental_interaction: Stable across wide greenhouse temperature ranges (20-32°C); durable against field resistance breakdown.

disease_susceptibility_profile.interpretation: Genotype '0/1' (HET) at Ty-1 (p.Arg483His). Result: Moderate Tolerance. Introgression polymorphism in RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (SlRDR1) that hyperactivates transcriptional gene silencing of begomovirus/geminivirus genomes.
disease_susceptibility_profile.environmental_interaction: Vector pressure (Bemisia tabaci whiteflies) at temperatures >28°C increases inoculation load; heterozygous Ty-1/ty-1 shows mild symptoms under extreme whitefly pressure.

disease_susceptibility_profile.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici race 2
disease_susceptibility_profile.interpretation: Genotype '1/1' (HOM_ALT) at I-2 (p.Ile653Val). Result: Conferred Resistance. NBS-LRR resistance allele recognizing the secreted Avr2 protein of Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici race 2.
disease_susceptibility_profile.environmental_interaction: Soil temperatures between 25-28°C highly favor Fusarium infection in susceptible plants; resistant plants maintain vascular integrity.

disease_susceptibility_profile.interpretation: Genotype '0/1' (HET) at Ve1 (p.Gln312Ter). Result: Conferred Resistance. Premature truncation mutation in the extracellular LRR receptor Ve1 causing loss of Verticillium Ave1 effector recognition.
disease_susceptibility_profile.environmental_interaction: Disease manifestation is elevated in cool soils (20-24°C) with moist conditions.

disease_susceptibility_profile.interpretation: Genotype '1/1' (HOM_ALT) at Pto (p.Thr204Asp). Result: Conferred Resistance. Autophosphorylation activation domain variant in Pto Ser/Thr kinase enabling physical complex formation with AvrPto and Prf-mediated signaling.
disease_susceptibility_profile.environmental_interaction: Prolonged leaf wetness (>90% humidity) and cool temperatures (18-24°C) trigger severe bacterial speck outbreaks in susceptible crops.
